## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run build` and `npm test` pass locally.
- [ ] A changeset is included (`npx changeset`) if a published package changed. Docs-only and tooling-only changes need none.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests, including an axe check for anything rendered.
- [ ] Component changes update the example file, the JSDoc `@example`, and the Web Component (or note why not).
- [ ] Token or style changes use tokens, not hardcoded values.
- [ ] Docs reflect the change.
